findings.passage: Stopping the Left's voter fraud schemes to safeguard our elections
findings.note: Bullet on his campaign home page under what he says he is delivering. The page is undated. It does not name voter ID or citizenship proof.

findings.passage: “This is a low-cost, high-value measure,” said state Rep. John LaHood, a Republican from Valdosta who sponsored the bill. “The voter can see it with their eyes. ... This is a visible security feature that will be printed on the ballots.”
findings.note: AJC quotes him on HB 976, which adds a watermark to Georgia ballots. The House passed it 167-1. Ballot security, not voter ID.
HB 976 adds a watermark to ballots, as reported by the AJC.

findings.passage: “Those who want to count for themselves and inspect can do so to their heart’s content,” said LaHood, a Republican from Valdosta and chairman of the House Governmental Affairs Committee.
findings.note: AJC quotes him on HB 974, which would post ballot images online after elections. Transparency, not voter ID.
HB 974 would post ballot images online after elections, as reported by the AJC.
